Evidence: Nemotron reports checkpoint-vs-full KL/top-token/NLL (98.4% top-token agreement; NLL 0.0692 to 0.0749), a cold 8,192-token prompt at 4.41 s vs 7.96 s (1.81x), TP=1 vs TP=2 same tokens on 8 release prompts/17 replies, drafted replies equal to `"draft": false`, 2/4 concurrent streams equal to solo runs, three-turn chats equal to cache-off, four concurrent streams at 6.2 s vs 11.8 s, and an image request with first token at 11.45 s and 22.9 GiB free. DeepSeek reports the token-map generator validating release geometry and recording SHA256, `aot-needs` running the actual symbolic planner on CPU, Triton reference tools compiling for the actual target SM and writing `aot/`, required revisions/compiler versions/manifests/hashes, no substitution of captured images, and that compile-only targets use inert synthetic images and cannot produce a serving qualification receipt. MiniMax reports `tf-h3-dit` running every denoising forward, printing first-forward velocities against the reference, writing final video/audio rows and first-forward velocities, requiring M5 tensor units, and that `dense` leaves the pooled branch out and is not how the checkpoint was trained; 13 kernels are registered against formulas.
